cards.term: As x goes from 0 to π/2, how do sin x and cos x change?
cards.definition: sin x increases 0 → 1; cos x decreases 1 → 0

cards.term: Quick rule for allied angles like (π/2 ± x), (π ± x), (3π/2 ± x)?
cards.definition: Odd multiple of π/2: sin ↔ cos, tan ↔ cot. Even multiple: same function. Sign: the original function in that quadrant
cos(π/2 − x): sin x; sin(π/2 + x): cos x; cos(π/2 + x): −sin x; sin(π − x): sin x; cos(π − x): −cos x; sin(π + x): −sin x; sin(2π − x): −sin x
